question: A man walks from P to Q at a speed 10 km/h, but comes back from Q to P at 12 km/h. Find his average speed.
solution:
**Given: **

Speed from P to Q = 10 km/h,

Speed from Q to P = 12 km/h

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

**Calculation: **

Average speed = 2 × (Speed P to Q × Speed Q to P) / (Speed P to Q + Speed Q to P)

⇒ Average speed = 2 × (10 × 12) / (10 + 12)

⇒ 120/11 ≈ 10(10)/(11) km/h

**∴ The average speed is approximately 10(10)/(11) km/h.**
